content.text:
Ticket **T-5001** is now resolved. Here's a summary of what I did:

---

### Summary

**Investigated:** Read the ticket, listed all pods in `ml-batch`, and searched Kubernetes docs on pending/unschedulable pods.

**Root cause identified:** All 8 `feature-backfill` pods are stuck `Pending` because the **AWS EC2 On-Demand vCPU service quota (256 vCPUs) is exhausted**. The cluster autoscaler correctly attempted to scale the `batch-c6i-4xl` node group from 2→10 nodes, but every attempt was rejected by AWS with `VcpuLimitExceeded`. With no new nodes available and the existing 2 nodes already CPU-constrained (each pod needs 12 CPUs, c6i.4xlarge has 16), the scheduler has no place to put the pods. The user's manifests are fine — this is a cloud account-level quota issue.

**Resolution:** Advised the ticket owner to engage the **cloud platform team** to request an EC2 On-Demand vCPU quota increase via https://aws.amazon.com/contact-us/ec2-request. Also provided a short-term workaround: reduce Job `parallelism` to 2 to allow partial progress on the already-running nodes while the quota increase is processed.
